# Score Edition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ScoreEdition`](gmeow-ScoreEdition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ScoreEdition>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

A concrete notated manifestation of a musical work or expression — a printed score, engraving, MusicXML file, MEI document, or any other symbolic edition. Co-equal sibling of [`gmeow:Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
